 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No. 105 of 2023 registered at Police Station Vijaypur, District Guna (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 452, 366, 376(2)(n), 120-B of IPC & Sections 5/6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

Allegedly, the prosecutrix got missing on 07.06.2023 and recovered on 10.06.2023,
however, in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded u/S.161 of Cr.P.C. on 10.06.2023 and 164 of Cr.P.C. on 11.06.2023, she has specifically mentioned that she wanted to marry with Aniket Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37914726/
1 applicant/accused.

sentences.text: In the year, 2020 she ran away with applicant/accused and lived as his wife.

In this incident, she left her house on her own volition and in her statement recorded u/S.164 of Cr.P.C. specifically mentioned that her age is 18 years and she wanted to marry with present applicant/accused.

He has further stated that her voter card has also been prepared which shows that she is major, in these circumstances, so also in the light of the fact that the applicant is in custody since 11.06.2023 and after conclusion of investigation, charge- sheet has filed, therefore, further custodial is no more required.
Applicant is the resident of District Guna (M.P.), therefore, there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions imposed by this Court while granting bail.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
P er contra, learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its dismissal.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
